atomic_cutover: Retire the production Staff Messaging dependency on models/users: total 127 -> 126; #4074 10 -> 9. Define complete native thread, message, inbox and addressable-colleague records and a precise two-field sender-name projection. Application and workflow values are defined types, not Go aliases. Existing bound thread/message/read stores advertise native public facets alongside retained callers, using the exact same legacy implementations and actual stores; the staffstore carrier key remains visible. Native workflow adapters bind only these owned facets. Every stored field, nullable preview field, role label, tenant ID, ID and DB timestamp survives. Native create forwards returned metadata and original errors, while workflow pointer conversions preserve source partial mutations even on errors. Preserve nil/empty collections and nil entries, context, participant/account/read selectors, cursor ordering, append locks, retention cutoffs, canonical participant keys and query count. Staff authorization remains participation only: no role/admin substitution. Root name binding performs exactly the original person read and retains both original name parts, nil/partial errors and the workflow trim/fallback behavior. No foreign-public application grant, new rule, Go type alias, classification, exception, Root graph field or increased budget. Rules 844, epoch 72, composition 1657, Communication compose 1486 and total compose 34584 unchanged. Routes/responses/goldens/IoT, parent relationship permissions, sessions and wrong-portal rejection unchanged.
